newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's bourse ends session 0.19 pct lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's bourse ends session 0.19 pct lower.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed 0.19 percent lower despite higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 446.64 points, down from 447.50 on Wednesday.
Total volume was 743,126 dinars against 365,964 dinars over the previous session.
Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel was up 0.23 dinar to 7.99 dinars. Airline Tunis Air rose 0.2 dinar to 23.2 dinars with 6,075 shares changing hands.
Societe Frigorifique et Brasserie de Tunis fell 0.98 dinar to 76.02 dinars. Retail stores Monoprix was down 0.96 dinar to 31.24. Chemical firm Alkimia eased 0.48 dinar to 40.52 dinars.
Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie edged lower 0.3 dinar to 29.2 dinars.
